Germany has learned that Russia plans to halt the flow of Kazakh oil through the Druzhba pipeline to the PCK refinery in eastern Germany starting May 1, 2026 the energy ministry in Berlin told AFP on April 22, 2026. The move comes amid Russia's war against Ukraine and a global energy crisis linked to the US-Israeli war against Iran, which has caused major disruptions to global oil and gas markets.
